title: configure nextcloud-mcp-server settings
description: Configure the Nextcloud MCP server, its Traefik route, and the external Ollama embedding endpoint. Clients authenticate to /mcp with HTTP Basic Auth. Nextcloud username and app password are not stored.

host.description: Traefik host name for the MCP endpoint, like 'mcp.example.com'

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all the HTTP requests to HTTPS

nextcloud_host.description: Nextcloud base URL, without a trailing slash

nextcloud_username.description: Obsolete and ignored. Not stored. Each MCP client sends its own Nextcloud user name in an Authorization: Basic header.

nextcloud_password.description: Obsolete and ignored. Not stored. Each MCP client sends its own Nextcloud app password in an Authorization: Basic header.

ollama_base_url.description: Base URL of an external Ollama server, for example http://pc01:11434. Not validated while enable_semantic_search is false. When semantic search is on, the module validator requires http(s)://host[:port] where host is a hostname (a dot is not required), an IPv4 address, or an IPv6 address.

ollama_embedding_model.description: Ollama embedding model name. The model must already be pulled on that host. Required only when enable_semantic_search is true.

enable_semantic_search.description: Enable Qdrant semantic search. Default is true. When true, ollama_base_url and ollama_embedding_model are required by the module validator. When false, both may be empty or kept from an earlier save.
